item.title: Linda Perry Talks ‘Let It Die Here’ Documentary & Album, Plus 4 Non Blondes’ ‘What’s Up?’ Viral Moment: ‘You Can’t Buy That Kind of Marketing’
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the latest music news and trends. Today, we're shining the spotlight on the one and only Linda Perry. From her iconic days as the frontwoman of 4 Non Blondes to her impressive songwriting catalog and solo career, Linda has lived a life full of music and passion.
[Soft music transitions in]
Host: Linda recently released a new documentary, "Linda Perry: Let It Die Here," which premiered at the 2024 Tribeca Film Festival and is now in select theaters. Alongside the film, she also dropped her first solo album in over a decade, "Let It Die Here." We had the chance to sit down with Linda and talk about her latest projects.
[Clip of Linda Perry's voice plays]
Linda Perry: "I didn't know an album was coming. I didn't know I was there yet... I was like, 'Holy sh–. I guess I've got something to say after all.'"
Host: Linda's new album is a testament to her organic creative process. She also reunited with her 4 Non Blondes bandmates for new performances and a new album, set to release this year. We talked to her about what inspired her to create this new music and her thoughts on the viral resurgence of their 1993 hit "What's Up?"
[Clip of Linda Perry's voice plays]
Linda Perry: "My process has always been to let things happen organically... I have my Neil Diamond moment... and it's like, 'What the hell? Where is this coming from?' But it's what the song is asking."
Host: One of the standout tracks on the album is Linda's cover of Christina Aguilera's "Beautiful," which she originally wrote for the pop star in 2002.
[Clip of Linda Perry's voice plays]
Linda Perry: "I can go and redo this song and make it sound completely different... This is the way I wanted it back then, so I'm just gonna do the version I would have done for myself."
Host: With a new documentary, album, and 4 Non Blondes reunion on the horizon, Linda Perry is proving that she's still a force to be reckoned with in the music industry. We can't wait to see what she has in store for us next.
[Outro music plays]
Host: Thanks for tuning in to our podcast. If you want to hear more from Linda Perry, check out her full conversation with us on our website. Don't forget to follow us for the latest music news and updates. Until next time, keep on listening!
